description: This Kotlin source file defines the ProcessRemoteActions class responsible for managing remote note operations (create, update, delete) in a synchronized manner, including batching and concurrency control, within a note-taking app.

classes.name: ProcessRemoteActions
classes.description: Handles processing of remote note operations with concurrency control, batching, and error handling.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Processes a remote operation (create, update, delete) for a specific note ID, managing concurrency and batching.

methods.name: deleteRemoteNotes
methods.description: Deletes a remote note from the backend and removes its ID mapping.

methods.name: insertRemote
methods.description: Creates a new remote note and updates local ID mappings and last modified timestamp.

methods.name: updateRemote
methods.description: Updates an existing remote note and its ID mapping.
